_readme: TITAN CONFIG — RECOMMENDED BLEND (old profitable + new improvements). See ANALYSIS.md for full reasoning.

MAX_BET_ABS._description: RESTORED to old value. New $3 cap was too tight — reduced trade frequency and profit ceiling.

MAX_BET_PCT._description: RESTORED to old value. 0.12 was strangling bet sizes on a $20 bankroll.

KELLY_FRACTION._description: RESTORED to old value. 0.20 was under-betting on good signals.

MIN_TRADE_CASH._description: Min USD for public feed trades.

MAX_TRADES_FETCH._description: RESTORED to old value. 200 was cutting discovery.

HOT_HOURS._description: Trades within this many hours are HOT.

WARM_HOURS._description: FIX: was 4 but caused constant '500 trade limit' warnings. Elite wallets are polled directly every cycle so public feed only needs HOT trades (2h). Reduces noise dramatically.

CYCLE_SECONDS._description: RESTORED to old value. 20s cycles mean missed HFT spikes. The API load concern is secondary to alpha capture.

HFT_POLL_LIMIT._description: Keep new value — fast traders were hitting 50-trade wall.

HFT_MIN_TRADES_PER_HOUR._description: Keep new value — catch HFT wallets earlier.

HFT_SPIKE_MIN_ABS_CASH._description: RESTORED to old value. 400 was catching too much noise. The $700 floor kept signals high quality.

ELITE_POLL_LIMIT._description: Keep new value — fast traders were hitting limit.

ELITE_TRADE_MIN_FRACTION._description: RESTORED to old value. 0.03 introduced too many small trades.

MAX_SIGNAL_AGE_H._description: COMPROMISE: old=0.4h (24min), new=1.0h. 0.4h was quite tight; 1.0h too loose. 0.5h (30min) is the sweet spot.

MIN_SCORE._description: RESTORED to old value. 65 was blocking too many valid signals — the old system was profitable at 48.

ALERT_SCORE._description: RESTORED to old value. Raising to 75 killed too many tradeable signals.

MAX_DRIFT._description: RESTORED to old value. 0.03 was rejecting signals that had already moved slightly but still had positive EV.

MAX_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE._description: RESTORED to old value. 0.02 was too tight — rejecting real signals.

HFT_MAX_DRIFT._description: Keep new stricter HFT value — HFT spikes must still be fresh.

MIN_LIQUIDITY._description: COMPROMISE: old=5000, new=30000. 30k blocked most of Polymarket. 5k allowed illiquid traps. 10k is safe but permissive.

MIN_VOLUME._description: COMPROMISE: old=5000, new=75000. 75k was way too restrictive. 20k filters the worst markets without killing most signals.

MIN_HOURS_LEFT._description: COMPROMISE: old=0.5, new=6.0. 0.5h allowed near-expiry traps; 6h blocked too many valid markets. 2h is balanced.

ELITE_MIN_PNL._description: RESTORED to old value. The new $15k threshold was admitting too many mid-tier wallets as 'elite' and diluting signal quality.

ELITE_MIN_PORT._description: RESTORED to old value. $50k let in too many smaller wallets.

MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS._description: RESTORED to old value. 3 was too few — missed diversification and reduced total profit opportunity.

MAX_POSITIONS_PER_WHALE._description: RESTORED to old value. 1 was too restrictive — blocked valid follow-on signals from proven elite whales.

PROFIT_TARGET_PCT._description: Unchanged — let the market and whale decide exit.

STOP_LOSS_ENABLED._description: RESTORED to false. The new stop loss at -35% was cutting positions that whales were still holding through — costing real money.

STOP_LOSS_PCT._description: Effectively disabled. Whale exit IS the stop loss.

EXIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS._description: RESTORED to old value. 900s (15min) cooldown was blocking re-entry on fast-moving markets that genuinely reset.

vip_wallets._description: Polled every single cycle regardless of elite status.

wallets.note: neutralwave23 — HFT spike trader (keep from new version)

seed_watchlist._description: Wallets added to watchlist on first boot.
